Q27. Find the zeroes of the quadratic polynomial 6x^2 − 3 − 7x and verify the relationship between the zeroes and the coefficients.

Answer / Solution:
Polynomial: 6x^2 - 7x - 3
Factorization:
6x^2 - 9x + 2x - 3 = 3x(2x-3) + 1(2x-3) = (3x+1)(2x-3)
Zeroes: x = -1/3 and x = 3/2
Verification:
Sum = 3/2 + (-1/3) = (9-2)/6 = 7/6
-b/a = -(-7)/6 = 7/6 (verified)
Product = (3/2)(-1/3) = -1/2
c/a = (-3)/6 = -1/2 (verified)
